DDInter661.mechanism: Coadministration with agents that can alter serum phosphate levels may affect the initial dosage determination of erdafitinib. The mechanism appears to be related to the pharmacodynamic effects of fibroblast growth factor receptor (FGFR) inhibition by erdafitinib. Inhibition of the FGFR receptor has been shown to lead to an increase in serum phosphate levels.
